chunks: Abān narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Aʿyan, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
That he disliked staying at al-Mashʿar after the departure.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam transmitting the ruling
key_terms.الْإِفَاضَةِ: the departure or movement onward from a ritual station
key_terms.الْمَشْعَرِ: al-Mashʿar, the sacred site associated with the hajj rites

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to remain at al-Mashʿar after departing from it during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a disliked act related to the rites of hajj, namely remaining at al-Mashʿar after the prescribed departure. It reflects a jurisprudential teaching transmitted from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning proper conduct in the pilgrimage rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2986 - Aban narrated from Abdul-Rahman ibn A'yan, from Abu Ja'far (as):
He disliked staying at Al-Mash'ar after departing from it.
